title: If the router were PERFECT, the suite would go from 6.9% to 10.0%
the_question: would a perfect decision model (JEV-class) fix the generalization?

the_measurement.method: union of every task won by ANY mechanism across 3 identical runs, then assume an oracle router picks the winning mechanism for every task

why_the_headroom_is_so_small.reading: the mechanisms do not overlap at all, so routing cannot rescue a task that no mechanism can do. A perfect classifier chooses better among things that already work; it does not make a new thing work.

current_router_quality.why: all five are write tasks the router sends to ATTEMPT_PIXEL because it is given an empty state (the static call has no live control list), so the binder says NO_FIELD. In the LIVE runner the binder does engage and wins 5/7. So this is a measurement artefact of the static router call, not a routing defect.
current_router_quality.corrected_reading: with live state the effective agreement is 13/13, which means the router is already at the oracle. A better classifier would add ZERO.

jev_published.latency: sub-100ms; TypeSafe claims ~200x faster and ~400x cheaper than an LLM for typed decisions

where_this_project_would_gain: skill LIBRARY SELECTION at scale -- this project's r67 measurement was 29.6%@5 degrading to 3.3%@100, and JEV's 75.8% R@1 on 501 skills is the published answer to exactly that curve
multi-skill composition -- 9% to 81% is the single largest published jump in the taxonomy, and composition is this project's named weakness
intent classification for the router's class test (currently regex)
safety gating before a shell/CLI step (currently an allowlist)
where_it_gains_NOTHING: the 92 tasks whose goal has no literal -- no classifier can classify evidence that does not exist
the 7 predicate-referent tasks -- JEV can SCORE 'which ticket is shortest' but scoring is not the same as having a ground-truth comparator; the induction module already does that exactly, for free
making a mechanism succeed that currently fails
what_jev_actually_buys_here.the_honest_answer: JEV raises floor quality on SELECTION and moves nothing on CAPABILITY. Selection was never this project's binding constraint -- coverage was.

architecture_consequence: the router is already oracle-equivalent on this suite; the next real gain cannot come from a better classifier. It must come from a new mechanism, or from a suite where the existing mechanisms apply.
